text:
Type: clear glass vases, set of two
Use: holding single stems or small bouquets on a table, shelf or windowsill; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: clear glass with gentle hand-formed irregularities
Colors: clear transparent glass
Shape: two bottle-like vases in different sizes, organic rounded bodies that taper into narrow necks with a flared lip, slightly irregular outline, light and airy
Feel: delicate, fresh, airy, calm
Goes with: green stems, white walls, light wood, linen; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: VRVIND
product.description: The unique shape makes the vases beautiful both with and without flowers.
